Allah hi ke liye mahw-e-tasbeeh hai jo kuch bhi zameen o aasmaan mein hai, aur wahi saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Wahi woh hai jis ne ahl-e-kitaab ke kaafiron ko pehle hi hashr mein un ke watan se nikaal baahar kiya. Tum to us ka tasawwur bhi nahin kar rahe the ke yeh nikal sakenge, aur un ka bhi yahi khayaal tha ke un ke qile inhein Khuda se bacha lenge, lekin Khuda aise rukh se pesh aaya jis ka inhein wahm o gumaan bhi nahin tha, aur un ke dilon mein ro'b paida kar diya ke woh apne gharon ko khud apne haathon se aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke haathon se ujaadne lage. To saahibaan-e-nazar! Ibrat haasil karo
Aur agar Khuda ne un ke haq mein jila-watani na likh di hoti to un par duniya hi mein azaab naazil kar deta, aur aakhirat mein to Jahannam ka azaab tai hi hai
Yeh is liye ke unhon ne Allah aur Rasool se ikhtilaaf kiya, aur jo Khuda se ikhtilaaf kare us ke haq mein Khuda sakht azaab karne waala hai
Musalmaano! Tum ne jo bhi khajoor ki shaakh kaati hai ya use us ki jadon par rehne diya hai yeh sab Khuda ki ijaazat se hua hai, aur is liye taake Khuda faasiqeen ko ruswa kare

Aur Khuda ne jo kuch un ki taraf se maal-e-ghaneemat apne Rasool ko dilwaaya hai jis ke liye tum ne ghode ya oont ke zariye koi daud-dhoop nahin ki hai, lekin Allah apne rasoolon ko ghalaba inaayat karta hai aur woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Jo kuch bhi Allah ne ahl-e-qarya ki taraf se apne Rasool ko dilwaaya hai woh sab Allah, Rasool aur Rasool ke qaraabat-daar, aitaam, masaakeen aur musaafiraan-e-ghurbat-zada ke liye hai, taake saara maal sirf maaldaaron ke darmiyaan ghoom phir kar na reh jaaye. Aur jo kuch bhi Rasool tumhein de de use le lo aur jis cheez se mana kar de us se ruk jaao, aur Allah se daro ke Allah sakht azaab karne waala hai

Yeh maal un muhaajir fuqara ke liye bhi hai jinhein un ke gharon aur amwaal se nikaal baahar kar diya gaya hai, aur woh sirf Khuda ke fazl aur us ki marzi ke talabgaar hain aur Khuda o Rasool ki madad karne waale hain, ke yahi log da'wa-e-imaan mein sachche hain

Aur jin logon ne Daar-ul-Hijrat aur imaan ko un se pehle ikhtiyaar kiya tha woh hijrat karne waalon ko dost rakhte hain, aur jo kuch inhein diya gaya hai apne dilon mein us ki taraf se koi zaroorat nahin mehsoos karte hain, aur apne nafs par doosron ko muqaddam karte hain chaahe inhein kitni hi zaroorat kyon na ho. Aur jise bhi us ke nafs ki hirs se bacha liya jaaye wahi log najaat paane waale hain

Aur jo log un ke baad aaye aur un ka kehna yeh hai ke Khudaaya! Humein maaf kar de aur hamaare un bhaiyon ko bhi jinhon ne imaan mein hum par sabqat ki hai, aur hamaare dilon mein saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye kisi tarah ka keena na qaraar dena ke tu bada meharbaan aur rahm karne waala hai

Kya tum ne munaafiqeen ka haal nahin dekha hai ke yeh apne ahl-e-kitaab kaafir bhaiyon se kehte hain ke agar tumhein nikaal diya gaya to hum bhi tumhaare saath nikal chalenge aur tumhaare baare mein kisi ki itaa'at na karenge, aur agar tum se jang ki gayi to bhi hum tumhaari madad karenge, aur Khuda gawaah hai ke yeh sab bilkul jhoote hain

Woh agar nikaal bhi diye gaye to yeh un ke saath na niklenge, aur agar un se jang ki gayi to yeh hargiz un ki madad na karenge, aur agar madad bhi karenge to peeth pher kar bhaag jaayenge, phir un ki koi madad karne waala na hoga
Musalmaano! Tum un ke dilon mein Allah se bhi zyaada khauf rakhte ho, yeh is liye ke yeh qaum samajhdaar nahin hai

Yeh kabhi tum se ijtimaai taur par jang na karenge magar yeh ke mahfooz bastiyon mein hon ya deewaaron ke peechhe hon. Un ki dhaak aapas mein bahut hai aur tum yeh khayaal karte ho ke yeh sab muttahid hain, hargiz nahin, un ke dilon mein sakht tafriqa hai, aur yeh is liye ke is qaum ke paas aql nahin hai
Jis tarah ke abhi haal mein un se pehle waalon ka hashr hua hai ke unhon ne apne kaam ke wabaal ka maza chakh liya hai, aur phir un ke liye dardnaak azaab bhi hai
Un ki misaal Shaitaan jaisi hai ke us ne insaan se kaha ke kufr ikhtiyaar kar le, aur jab woh kaafir ho gaya to kehne laga ke main tujh se bezaar hoon, main to aalameen ke Parwardigar se darta hoon
To un dono ka anjaam yeh hai ke dono Jahannam mein hamesha hamesha rehne waale hain, aur yahi zaalimeen ki waaqai saza hai
Imaan waalo! Allah se daro aur har shakhs yeh dekhe ke us ne kal ke liye kya bhej diya hai, aur Allah se darte raho ke woh yaqeenan tumhaare aamaal se baakhabar hai
Aur khabardaar un logon ki tarah na ho jaana jinhon ne Khuda ko bhula diya to Khuda ne khud un ke nafs ko bhi bhula diya, aur woh sab waaqai faasiq aur badkaar hain
Ashaab-e-Jannat aur ashaab-e-Jahannam ek jaise nahin ho sakte. Ashaab-e-Jannat wahi hain jo kaamyaab hone waale hain

Hum agar is Quran ko kisi pahaad par naazil kar dete to tum dekhte ke pahaad khauf-e-Khuda se larzaan aur tukde tukde hua ja raha hai, aur hum in misaalon ko insaanon ke liye is liye bayaan karte hain ke shaayad woh kuch ghaur o fikr kar sakein
Woh Khuda woh hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur woh haazir o ghaaib sab ka jaanne waala, azeem aur daaimi rehmaton ka maalik hai

Woh Allah woh hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Woh baadshaah, paakeeza sifaat, be-aib, amaan dene waala, nigraani karne waala, saahib-e-izzat, zabardast aur kibriyaai ka maalik hai. Woh un tamaam baaton se paak o paakeeza hai jo mushrikeen kiya karte hain

Woh aisa Khuda hai jo paida karne waala, eejaad karne waala aur sooratein banaane waala hai. Us ke liye behtareen naam hain. Zameen o aasmaan ka har zarra usi ke liye mahw-e-tasbeeh hai, aur woh saahib-e-izzat o hikmat hai
